info.title: sqlclone
info.description: Clone a SQL Server database, schema and data, from one server to another under a new name.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Clone a SQL Server database, including all objects and data, to another server.

options.name: --source
options.description: Connection string for the source database (must include the database name).

options.name: --target
options.description: Connection string for the target server. Any database name in it is ignored.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name to give the cloned database on the target server.

options.name: --force
options.description: Drop the target database first if it already exists and isn't empty. [default: False]

options.name: --use-existing
options.description: Clone into the target database as it is, even if it isn't empty, leaving what's in it alone. Stops before writing anything if any of it has a name the clone would give. [default: False]

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Number of tables to copy concurrently. [default: 4]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the source and target and say what the clone would do, without writing anything. [default: False]
